## Highlights since 0.5.0

- **A more polished interface.** Highlights get one colour panel with a paper preview, a readability check, an eyedropper and paper tones. The highlighter menu marks the pen's colour and lets you rename meanings in place. `\colorbox` highlights are painted in the LaTeX source. Comments split into Notes | Highlights with a colour filter. Settings pictures each theme as a window miniature, shows code themes as light|dark cards, takes a custom accent colour, and narrows to a section list with a back button.
- **Import files.** Import files… in the Project tree, its menus and the command palette brings any files and folders in from the Mac. Name clashes ask once per batch: keep both, replace or skip. Finder drops onto the tree use the same path, and a live-synced Overleaf project syncs the new files.
- **Smoother panel resizing.** Dividers follow the pointer without restyling the workspace every frame, and the resize cursor holds for the whole drag. In the WebKit browser benchmark, dragging the Markdown source/preview split went from a 78 ms worst frame to 28 ms and from 83 to 272 pointer moves handled in 2 s. Work per frame on the left column dropped from 18 to 11 ms. Grabbing and releasing a divider next to a long document no longer hitches by 40–80 ms. These are measured before/after fixtures, not release-app timing guarantees; details are in [the performance notes](https://github.com/leo1oel/lattice/blob/v0.6.0/docs/performance.md).
- **Clear Overleaf sessions.** An expired Overleaf sign-in is detected once and shown the same way everywhere: Settings asks you to sign in again, and sync and live editing stop instead of retrying forever.
- **A better Agent panel.** Synara is updated to 1.0.4 and resumes chats after an unexpected stop. In the light theme, the panel's bubbles, code and starter cards use the editor's #fafafa page. Agent questions open expanded, and Codex's suggested follow-ups appear as chips that fill the composer. The panel keeps its grey page and earlier images after a question.

## Notable fixes

- The selected tab is a filled plate a step deeper than its panel, not an outline.
- Presentations: a closed or reloaded window no longer blocks every other project's deck, and a deck open elsewhere offers to switch to that window. A fixed deck drops its stale build error, assets stay where the agent wrote them, and the agent's page preview reports build errors.
- No focus ring appears under the pointer; confirmations are centred and keep their paragraph breaks; panel tabs are inset evenly with concentric corners.
- New file and New folder keep their name field, and empty panels are centred.
- The outline and every editor popover arrive on the popup motion tier; Papers' Filter and Sort open as fast as the other menus, and Settings navigation hover follows the pointer.
